incident: The control. A real bot version bump must pass, or the guard gets disabled and the author-versus-content hole is back with a suite that says otherwise. Validated against all four open bot PRs (#465-#468) on 2026-09-22. TWO CORRECTIONS SINCE, both caught by this harness rather than by review: its needle read 'manifests or lockfiles' and went stale when the success message was reworded; and it carried NO --diff, which only passed while `package.json` was approved by PATH. That path approval was the hole -- `ci.yml` executes `format:check`, `lint`, `typecheck`, `test` and `build`, every one a `package.json` script -- so the fixture now supplies the diff a real npm PR carries, and the case tests the passing direction of a content rule instead of the absence of one.
